Package com.sicomsa.dmt.svc

Class SolicitaService.SolicitaResponseExtended

java.lang.Object
com.sicomsa.dmt.SatResponse
com.sicomsa.dmt.SolicitaResponse
com.sicomsa.dmt.svc.SolicitaService.SolicitaResponseExtended
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
SolicitaService
public static class SolicitaService.SolicitaResponseExtended extends SolicitaResponse
SolicitaResponseExtended is SAT's response from a download request to the massive download web service when requesting a download for the first time of a particular query, including the RFC of the requesting party as of version 1.5 released by SAT on 2025-05-30.

    • SolicitaResponseExtended

      public SolicitaResponseExtended(Instant satInstant, String statusCode, String message, String requestId)
      Returns a SolicitaResponse with the given parameters.
      Parameters:
      satInstant - Instant mesage was received from SAT
      statusCode - status code of the received message
      message - message received
      requestId - IdSolicitud attribute. Could be null according to wsdl, however method isAccept will return false if no requestId was provided from SAT.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if satInstant is null
